name: list_systems
description: List all registered systems in the manufacturing Unified Knowledge Graph, optionally filtered by plant, system type, or status. Returns system metadata including system_id, plant, system_type, display_name, and connection details.

plant.description: Filter by plant name (e.g. 'Indianapolis'). Omit to return all plants.

system_type.description: Filter by system type (e.g. 'ERP', 'MES', 'CMMS', 'PLM'). Omit to return all types.

status.description: Filter by status. Defaults to 'active'. Use null to return all statuses.

name: get_system_schema
description: Get all schema entries (tables/endpoints) and field metadata for a specific registered system. Returns table schemas with column details and field-level concept mappings.

outputSchema.description: Schema and field details for the system

name: find_by_concept
description: Find all systems and fields mapped to a canonical manufacturing concept. Uses GSI1 to discover which systems have fields mapped to the given concept. Prefer domain-qualified IDs (e.g. 'production.work-order', 'performance.oee', 'equipment.equipment-id'). Bare IDs are resolved automatically but may match multiple domains. Set compact=false to return full DynamoDB items instead of summaries.

concept_id.description: Domain-qualified concept identifier (e.g. 'production.work-order', 'performance.oee', 'equipment.equipment-id', 'production.batch-id'). Bare IDs like 'work-order' are resolved but may match multiple domains.

compact.description: When true (default), returns only system_id, table_name, field_name, data_type. When false, returns full DynamoDB items.

outputSchema.description: Systems and fields mapped to the concept

name: find_equivalences
description: Find cross-system field equivalence mappings for a concept. Uses GSI2 to discover how the same concept (e.g. 'production.work-order') is represented across different systems, enabling cross-system joins and translations.

inputSchema.description: Concept and optional source system filter

source_system.description: Optional source system ID to filter equivalences (e.g. 'sap-erp-indy').

name: get_canonical_concepts
description: Return the canonical manufacturing concept vocabulary with domain-qualified IDs, descriptions, and aliases. Call this to choose the correct concept_id BEFORE calling find_by_concept or find_equivalences, instead of guessing. The vocabulary is configured at runtime, so always consult it rather than assuming which concepts exist. Optionally filter to a single data domain.

domain.description: Filter to one data domain (e.g. 'production', 'maintenance', 'equipment', 'quality', 'performance'). Omit to return the full vocabulary.

concepts.description: Concept objects: id, domain, qualified_id, description, aliases
